ValidationRule.description: Checks whether order number is empty or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )), OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_OrderClassification__c , 'New Order'), ISBLANK( PMC_SS_SAPOrderNumber__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SAP Order Number must be entered for the New Order before Closing the Case.
